definition: To look thoughtfully for a long time at, or think about.
exampleSentence: She is contemplating accepting the fellowship offer in Zurich.

definition: To cause or arrange for something to take place at a time later than scheduled.
exampleSentence: Management decided to postpone launching the software product.

definition: To dare to do or say something that may be dangerous or risky.
exampleSentence: The startup hesitated to venture into international retail markets.

definition: To feel bitterness or indignation at a circumstance, action, or person.
exampleSentence: He resented having to justify his decisions to the steering committee.

definition: To make great efforts to achieve or obtain something.
exampleSentence: Educational institutions strive to cultivate independent critical thinkers.
